children: GlucoTrack said it entered a settlement agreement related to debt owed to Alto Opportunity Master Fund by Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US.

Under the terms of the settlement, GlucoTrack and other settling parties will make an initial payment of $2 million, and pay another $2 million pursuant to a convertible promissory note issued by GlucoTrack to Alto. In addition, GlucoTrack will pay up to $125,000 of Alto's legal fees, the company said.

Earlier this year, Apimeds Pharmaceuticals advanced Lokahi Therapeutics as an independent biopharmaceutical company focusing on the Apitox program. Apitox is a non-opiod biologic candidate being developed as a treatment for osteoarthritis.
In July, GlucoTrack and Lokahi completed a strategic business combination which saw Lokahi become the operating and controlling business of the combined company.
